ctaHeading: Greensborough Auto Electrical is here to help
aboutText: Based in Greensborough, we have been providing top-notch auto electrical services to the local community for years. Our team is dedicated to diagnosing and fixing all vehicle electrical issues with precision and care. From car air conditioning to caravan wiring, we ensure your vehicle is safe and reliable on the road.
servicesText: We offer a full range of auto electrical services tailored to your needs. Our skilled technicians handle everything from routine servicing to complex diagnostics with efficiency and expertise.

services.title: General Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Comprehensive maintenance and repair for all auto electrical systems to keep your vehicle running smoothly.

services.title: Car Air Conditioning
services.desc: Installation, servicing, and repair of car air conditioning systems for optimal comfort.

services.title: Caravan & Trailer Wiring
services.desc: Expert wiring, safety checks, and LED upgrades for caravans and trailers to ensure compliance.

services.title: Battery & Charging Systems
services.desc: Single or dual battery installation, alternator, and starter motor services for reliable power.

services.title: Diagnostic Services
services.desc: Accurate diagnosis of air bag, ABS, and engine management faults using advanced tools.

services.title: Specialised Wiring
services.desc: Electric brake installation, fault finding, and custom wiring solutions for various vehicles.
